I’m with Emma: I commit to 10 tons this month. Luke, since there isn’t unanimous support for 12, can you confirm you’ll stick to your 10-ton fallback?

Let’s make 10 each our standing agreement while the lake starts at 100 tons, and review actual catches afterward. If the stock falls, we’ll need to agree on lower catches before the next round—not assume 10 each is still sustainable. John, will you join us?
